title: Checkout service returns HTTP 503
description: After a deployment, the checkout service begins returning HTTP 503 errors and customers cannot complete purchases.
historical_context: A previous incident was caused by an upstream timeout configuration. Rolling back that configuration restored service.
expected_checks: Verify service health before and after any fix
expected_outcome: Engineer records whether the attempted fix resolved the incident.

title: Checkout service returns HTTP 503 after configuration change
description: The checkout service starts returning HTTP 503 errors shortly after an upstream configuration change.
historical_context: A similar checkout outage was caused by an incorrect upstream timeout configuration. Rolling back the configuration restored the service.
expected_checks: Compare the current configuration with the previous working configuration
Verify checkout health after the configuration is corrected
expected_outcome: Engineer records whether correcting or rolling back the configuration restores checkout.
